core_meaning.primary_meaning: Mustansar is an Arabic-origin name meaning “One who seeks help or victory”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Mustansar corresponds to the Arabic form مُسْتَنْصِر (Arabic root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r); مُسْتَنْصِر (Mustanṣir)). Its core sense is mustansir; one who seeks help or victory. Mustansar is a spelling variant of Arabic مُسْتَنْصِر (Mustanṣir) 'one who seeks help or victory', from the root ن ص ر (n-ṣ-r). The source gloss 'Support, Strength' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as mustansir.
